title: Claude Enterprise adds a security center, and hooks that can check a prompt before it runs
friendlyTitle: Claude Enterprise can now show its security settings in one place
summary: Anthropic added admin controls for Claude Enterprise. A security center, still in beta, compares chat, Cowork, and Claude Code settings with Anthropic's recommended configuration and can be downloaded as a report. Anthropic says it is guidance, not a certification. Inference hooks are generally available: prompt hooks send prompts to a company's existing security tool, and pre-tool-call hooks check a tool call before it runs. Centralized management, in beta, puts company-wide single sign-on, directory sync, and domain settings in one console at admin.claude.com. Setup cannot be undone. Admins can also sign a member out through the Admin API without removing them, manage an IP allowlist themselves, and block personal Claude accounts in Claude Desktop on managed computers. An endpoint sensor can run inside the Cowork virtual machine on the user's computer. Anthropic says those sensors report activity and do not block it, and that this does not cover Cowork sessions in the cloud.

whyItMatters: If your company already pays for Claude Enterprise, the new page is a checklist, not a guarantee. The hook that matters is the one that runs before a tool call, and only if your security tool is connected. A sign-out ends browser and device sessions. Anthropic says it does not end API keys, cloud sessions already running, or scheduled routines.
